candidates.name: enhanced_reasoning
candidates.hypothesis: A more detailed system prompt that explicitly encourages step-by-step reasoning, state tracking, and pattern analysis will improve performance on all problems, particularly the weak areas (linguini at 25% and shuffled_objects at 25%). By guiding the model to 'think deeply' and 'work through problems systematically', the model will be more careful with complex patterns and state changes without requiring complex detection logic.

candidates.name: structured_output
candidates.hypothesis: Explicitly requesting working/reasoning space in the task prompt before the final answer will improve accuracy on complex problems. By asking the model to 'work through step-by-step' and 'show reasoning' before giving the ANSWER, the model has explicit space to track state and verify patterns, reducing errors especially in shuffled_objects (25%) and linguini (25%) tasks.
